extra.message: The host query parameter is concatenated into os.system('ping -c 1 ' + host). A caller passing the INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN gate can supply shell metacharacters to execute arbitrary commands as the application process.

extra.message: pickle.loads() deserializes the request body or attacker-supplied blob query parameter, optionally decoded from base64. A caller passing the INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN gate can submit a malicious pickle that executes arbitrary Python code during deserialization.

cwe: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

extra.message: The fragment query parameter becomes executable Jinja2 template source in Template('Result: ' + fragment).render(). cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

extra.message: API authentication checks APIKey.is_active but never key.owner.is_active. Disabling an account through admin_user_edit leaves its keys usable. The subsequent authorization helpers check is_authenticated, role and course membership, which still pass for a disabled User object, allowing continued access to assignment data.

cwe: CWE-863: Incorrect Authorization

extra.message: With DEBUG enabled, as it is by default, the entire MEDIA_ROOT is served without authentication. Direct requests to /media/uploads/<year>/<month>/<filename> bypass download_document's ownership and course checks, exposing submission attachments and course resources to anyone who knows or guesses their paths.

cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization

extra.message: Course resource uploads accept HTML files: CourseResourceForm has no extension restriction, and Document.clean only checks extensions when an assignment exists. With the default DEBUG media route, uploaded HTML is served inline on the application's origin. An instructor can upload malicious HTML and send its media URL to another user, executing script with that user's application access.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation

extra.message: The XML parser enables DTD loading and external entity resolution, disables the network restriction, and parses request.body. When lxml is installed, a caller passing the INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN gate can trigger external resource resolution, including local-file entities and network requests where supported. The response only returns the root tag, so direct file-content disclosure is not established. lxml is not declared in requirements.txt.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: The lane GET or POST parameter is passed directly to redirect() without validating its host. Requests passing the INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN gate can redirect clients to arbitrary external HTTP or HTTPS destinations.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site

extra.message: Every accepted request logs the complete Authorization header and request body at WARNING level without redaction. Bearer credentials and sensitive payload values supplied to this endpoint are therefore copied into application logs.

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: The length query parameter directly controls an unbounded random-character generation loop and the resulting allocation. A caller passing the INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN gate can provide a very large integer in a small request, exhausting worker CPU and memory.

extra.message: The shared submission table renders s.grade_points without checking release status or viewer role. dashboard_student.html includes this table with recent submissions of every status from student_dashboard, exposing draft grades to students before release despite the restriction on submission_detail.

extra.message: assignment.documents.all() includes other students' submission attachments because submit_assignment associates each attachment with both its submission and assignment. assignment_detail.html renders every returned document's original filename and ID to enrolled students. Download authorization does not prevent this disclosure of other students' attachment metadata.

cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization

extra.message: course_detail returns assignments of every status to students, including unenrolled students when enrollment is open. cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization

extra.message: The grade CSV writes student-controlled full names directly into cells. ProfileForm accepts names beginning with formula characters such as '='. csv.writer escapes CSV delimiters but does not neutralize spreadsheet formulas, so a student's malicious name can execute as a formula when an instructor or administrator opens the export.

cwe: CWE-1236: Improper Neutralization of Formula Elements in a CSV File

extra.message: client_ip trusts the first X-Forwarded-For value without verifying that the request came through a trusted proxy. cwe: CWE-345: Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity

extra.message: SECRET_KEY falls back to the publicly known literal 'unsafe-local-dev-key-change-me' when DJANGO_SECRET_KEY is absent, including when DEBUG is disabled. Django signing operations then use a key available to attackers instead of an installation-specific secret.

cwe: CWE-321: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key

extra.message: DEBUG defaults to True. Unhandled application errors therefore expose Django technical error pages containing tracebacks, source context and local variables. Public registration can trigger such an error because the user-creation signal creates a Profile before register attempts to create the same one-to-one Profile again.

cwe: CWE-215: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Debugging Code

extra.message: The email backend is unconditionally configured to print messages to the console. This behavior remains enabled when DEBUG is False.

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: The cookie configuration sets HttpOnly and SameSite but never enables SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE, leaving Django's default False. Session cookies can consequently be transmitted over HTTP, exposing authenticated sessions to network interception when the application is accessed across an untrusted network.

cwe: CWE-614: Sensitive Cookie in HTTPS Session Without 'Secure' Attribute

extra.message: The documented seed command creates active accounts, including school administrator 'admin', using the fixed password 'DemoPass123!'. Anyone able to reach an installation retaining these demo credentials can authenticate with the corresponding privileges.

extra.message: The Compose configuration assigns the PostgreSQL superuser the fixed password 'postgres' and publishes port 5432 without a loopback binding. Where the host port is reachable, attackers can use these known credentials to access and modify the LMS database directly.
